title: Anti-dissociation: put back the feelings that are not yours
subtitle: Emotional contagion
intro: The phone is piled with other people's feelings. Click a knot, then the message it came from. Put back the ones that are not hers.
closing: The phone is still lit. She has not set it down.
doneLabel: Put the phone face down first

emotions.label: Anxiety
emotions.line: After the dose wears off I start dropping again.

emotions.label: Resentment
emotions.line: Why won't you answer me? Are you sick of me too?

emotions.label: Fear
emotions.line: I really can't hold on tonight.

emotions.label: Exhaustion
emotions.line: Only you understand me. Don't leave.

emotions.label: Helplessness
emotions.line: If you ignore me too, I'll really have no one.
